title: Drive controls with manual and tap tempo
body:
Animate controls from manual BPM and a tap clock with beat phase. User priority on 16 September: execute after reviewed LUX150/151 interfaces alongside the kick follow-up, ahead of Library164/165.

Reuse modulation bindings and clock ownership. Preserve saved identity, phase semantics and manual values. Do not add automatic audio beat estimation.

Acceptance: deterministic timing tests and actual Studio manual/tap demonstration; compatible save/reopen and control identity; independent review, integration and skill install/check.

Resolume host BPM/phase and host/export QA remain explicitly deferred by the user. Do not implement or claim host parity in this slice. Preserve LUX7/LUX59 stops. Reference: artifacts/refactor-audio-approved/brief.md.
reason: Prioritize manual/tap Studio delivery and retain explicit host deferral
